implemented: ReplayModel passes its immutable original base scanner and live prefix to the residual state; original flat zero padding is implicit.
Singleton prefix accumulator, MLE and padded OOD evaluations consume source-order linear contributions weighted by the already-fixed MSB fold prefix.
Extension cosets borrow the current residual state during commit and scatter into one native base-limb column-major buffer; the root retains only its existing folded getter.
One reusable base FFT column and both P3 twiddle tables serve base and extension cosets. The former full interleaved/row-major extension matrices are now test-only.
S1 retention scatters the same original contributions after the predecessor opening in the WHIR caller. A failed scan does not install partial S1 or discard pending source state.
After successful S1 retention the residual state drops its scanner and pending original references; historical root/snapshot owners remain. No physical checkpoint or GPU release claim.
The next fold is rejected while S1 retention is pending; no transcript barriers or PCS coins were moved.

After retention the residual does not scan the original source; retained Vec capacity remains reserved.
Reverse-order original emission and zero/one/extension prefix weights match the independent dense interleaved encoder.
Three nonzero extension pads per column keep their original offsets after the full folded column.
